generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- and Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.

All the Formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner. ( section 3 & 4 of the bid document ) and shall be uploaded properly, signed by Tenderer . Necessary Certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents Section can be used for this purpose.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.

The Tenderer should submit proposed methodology and program of construction, backed with equipment and materials duly supported with broad calculations and quality management, plan, proposed to be adopted, justifying of execution and completion of the work as per technical specifications within the stipulated period of completion.
Department will not supply any materials.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E-Procurement Portal.
The Employer reserves the right to reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Belagavi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a holiday next working day will hold good in lieu of the dates mentioned.

The contractor should employ only registered labours as per Govt. Circular No. PWD/198/BMS/2009/ Dated: 24-06-2009. As per EPF & MP act 1952 inrespect of of the employees angaged by or through contractors, agencies and contractors shall have provident fund code no. & all the contract employees deployed by them are enrolled as members of provident fund.
All materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on work.

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2 : Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation.

The tenderer shall obtain the workdone certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority Not Below the Rank of Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate. Certificates shall be produced to the Executive Engineer.

All the items include all Leads and Lifts,Loading and Unloading,Cost of materials, Labour, HOM of machineries as per Standard specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work and other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work.

The tenderer shall scan the original ownership document/ lease / hire committment Agreement scanned file to be attached to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced & copies attested by Notary/Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer and shall be submitted to the Executive Engineer.
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty charges on Construction materials and other taxes as applicable.
Physical quantities requirement to qualify the Tenderer is 80% of the estimated quantity as per Govt Order No. .PW/630/CRM/2014 Bangalore Dated: 17-11-2014
The Tenderer must submit uploaded documents duly attested by Gazzeted Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer and also produce original documents to the Executive Engineer for confirmation.
The item rates are inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

THE CONTRACTORS ARE INSTRUCTED TO SUBMIT ONLY RELEVENT INFORMATION WITH RECORDS AS REQUIRED AND SPECIFIED IN QUALIFICATION CRITERIA.ANY JUNK, SUPERFLOUS AND UNNECESARY DOCUMENTS IF UPLOADED WILL TREATED AS MISLEADING AND SUCH TENDERS ARE LIABLE TO BE REJECTED
The Project Completion Period is 06 (Six) Months and The Defects Liability Period is 1 YEAR after completion of work, the DLP is applicable to all the items executed in main work.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
The tenderer should be a Govt of Karnataka chief Electrical Inspectorates/BESCOM/KPTCL registered Class-II and Above contractor.
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) for Practicing Chartered Account is Preffered

APPEAL: As per Govt Ltr No: 572/CRM (2020) (E) Dtd: 03.10.2020 the Appeals received in E-Procurement as per KTPP Act / Rules within the stipulated time will only be considered. Any written appeal received shall not be considered.
The successful bidder, if he meets the conditions mentioned in the Govt. Circular No. PWD 48 BMS 2022, dt. 31.05.2024, will initiate the debarment of license.
Any deviation/error/mistake found in units of items, they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24(Contd for 2025-26) and the rates shall be quoted accordingly.
This Bid Document clause no 34.4 to be implemented as per Delegation of Power vide GO NO.PWD 423 FC-1 2018 Bangalore, Dated:24/09/2018

As per Govt. Circular No. FD 417 Exp-12/2024, dt. 09.08.2024 in case of revision of GST rates during the contract period, the Government and the contractor are bound to make payment / refund accordingly.
All necessary drawings, paper works, etc. and any other formalities required to be observed shall be the responsibility of contractor.

The contractor shall guarantee all the materials supplied by him including erection, electrification work for trouble free top class performance and against manufacturing defects for a period of one year from the date of satisfactory completion, commissioning and handing over to user department. The contractor shall make his own arrangement for rectifying defects/replacement of defective materials immediately on receipt of intimation from executing authority and power supply shall be restored. Failure of which, action will be taken to get the work rectification through other agency at the risk and cost of the contractor.
It is the responsibility of the contractor to pursue and obtain all necessary approvals related to work from respective departments.
The tenderer shall pass on to the department all the warranties, benefits etc., from the original equipment manufacturers.

The Contractor shall be solely responsible, not withstanding any stipulation by Owner or Engineer, for initiating, maintaining and supervising all safety precautions and programs in connection with the work and shall comply with all laws, ordinances, codes, rules, regulations and lawful orders of any public authority having jurisdiction for the safety of persons or property or to protect them from damages, injury or loss during the entire contract period, including non-working hours. Contractor shall maintain first aid facilities at site. All critical injuries shall be reported promptly to Engineer with a copy of Contractors report covering each personal injury, requiring the attention of a physician.

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer Or District level Officer and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
Tenderer shall note that the tenders those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation.

The entire work shall be carried out under the direct supervision of Officers in charge, Executive Engineer PWD Division Belagavi and Assistant Executive Engineer (Ele) Belagavi. In all cases of differences, disputes, etc., regarding the interpretation of specification of condition in general with any of the work, the decision of E.E PWD Division Belagavi, shall be final and binding on the contractor.

The bidders should submit the Bid capacity compulsorily. The details of balance work B value (works on hand & works for which tender submitted). Should be submitted in the prescribed format & should be signed by the concerned Executive Engineer / District level officer. In case the bidder does not furnish the above details/suppresses the actual facts/ produces false facts, along with the Technical bid, the technical bid of such bidder shall be considered for rejection.

It is the responsibility of contractor to co-ordinate with executing authority for commissioning the Street lights satisfactory by observing all formalities up to handing over to the user department. After this only, final bill will be paid.

It is the responsibility of the tenderer to prepare the as build sketch of detail Road lighting and hand over the same to the end user as per the instructions of the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-4 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26 executed the following minimum quantities of Supplying and erection of MS long hot dip Galvanized Conical dip pole 115 Each, Supply and Fixing of LED Street lights 230 Each, LT-UG Cable 7.60Km, HDPE pipe 3456 mtr,Earth work Excavation/filling- 2607 Cum, Steel reinforcement-4.61 Tonnes.

However it is obligatory for the contractor to use the fallowing machineries for various activities involved in construction as per MORTH specifications. Excavator Hydraulic Excavator/Backhoe Loader -Hired-1 No., Street light Ladder Vehicle -Hired-1 No. & Street light pole erection Vehicle -Hired-1 No.
